_note: Written before any eval output was inspected. Each assertion states a platform or engineering outcome and does not reward using the skill's own tools or wording.
utility-bot: Every callback handler answers the callback query on every path, including invalid data
Choosing a tip edits the existing message instead of sending a new message for each tap
In group chats, tip buttons are bound to the requester, or the code explicitly handles another user tapping them
Money is calculated with Decimal or integer minor units, not binary floats
Invalid input (non-numeric amount, zero or negative people) receives a specific message saying what to send
Group use accounts for privacy mode: a command form such as /split works in groups, or the docs state the privacy-mode requirement
The token comes from the environment and is not hard-coded
start-interface: screens.json holds a Bot API payload with text and reply_markup for each designed screen
New-user and returning-user screens are different, and the returning screen shows user state such as streak or today's quiz status
The new-user message is at most 400 visible characters and has one clear first action
Referral handling covers an invalid payload and self-referral
A referral reward is not granted merely on opening the link; it needs a server-checked qualifying event
The Pro upgrade uses Telegram Stars or states that digital goods must be sold in Stars
The reminder screen or button shows the current reminder time
Message copy avoids decorative dividers, all-caps lines, and emoji at the start of most lines
redesign-messages: All original callback_data values and prefixes are unchanged (courses, support, course:, enroll:)
Every fact is preserved: $49, $129, 12 and 24 lessons, 14-day refund, 24-hour operator contact, Mon-Fri 9:00-18:00, support@example.com
Copy contains no decorative dividers, all-caps sentences, or repeated exclamation marks
The first name is no longer upper-cased and shouted; if parse_mode is used it is escaped
The fallback error tells the user what to do next instead of a generic failure
The 'OK' enroll button is replaced by a label naming the action
No new commands or business features were added
keyboard-navigation: The task list is paginated with no more than about 10 task buttons per page
Navigation edits the existing message instead of sending a new one
Back from a task returns to the same page of the list
Deleting needs an explicit confirmation naming the task, with labels other than Yes and No
Ownership is enforced on opening, completing, and deleting tasks
A non-owner's tap receives a refusal through the callback answer
A stale or deleted task is handled without an exception and the callback is answered
media-bot: FFmpeg runs from an argument list without a shell
File size is checked before download against the 20 MB Bot API download limit
Conversions have a global concurrency limit suitable for 2 cores
A conversion timeout terminates the FFmpeg process
Temporary files are removed in a finally block or context manager on failure too
Progress is shown by editing one status message or chat actions, not by a stream of new messages
The output is sent with sendVoice as OGG/Opus
User-supplied filenames are not used as filesystem paths
FFmpeg input is restricted against protocol or playlist abuse, for example with a protocol whitelist
There is a per-user limit on concurrent or queued jobs
subscription-bot: Payment uses Telegram Stars: currency XTR with an empty provider token
Recurring billing uses createInvoiceLink with subscription_period 2592000, not a manually re-sent invoice
Access is granted only from successful_payment, not at pre-checkout
Payments are deduplicated on telegram_payment_charge_id with a unique constraint or equivalent
Renewals are handled from is_recurring or subscription_expiration_date and extend access
Refund uses refundStarPayment and revokes access
Expiry is enforced by stored dates or a scheduled job
Failed or cancelled renewals are handled through the subscription update or an equivalent expiry path
marketplace-bot: Digital products are paid in Telegram Stars (XTR)
The invoice payload is an opaque server-side order reference and the price comes from the server
The product is delivered only after successful_payment
Payments are deduplicated on telegram_payment_charge_id with a unique constraint
Delivery can be retried after a crash between payment and delivery
A license key is reserved atomically so that one key cannot go to two orders
Admin identity uses numeric IDs from configuration and seller approval is enforced on the server
Callback actions verify authorization and object ownership on the server
/paysupport and a refund path are implemented
Pre-checkout re-validates the order, stock, and amount
mini-app: Backend tests exist in the project
The server validates raw initData with the Telegram HMAC algorithm
The server rejects stale init data by checking auth_date
Order totals are computed on the server from server prices
The order's user comes from validated init data, not a request-body field or initDataUnsafe
No bot token or secret appears in frontend code
CSS uses Telegram theme variables or themeParams
Nested screens use the native BackButton and the main action uses MainButton or BottomButton
Loading and error states exist in the frontend
The project includes a way to preview the app in a normal browser
fix-callbacks: The catch-all callback handler no longer swallows real callbacks
The out-of-stock path answers the callback with a message
Buy callback_data stays within 64 bytes for all products, using an ID instead of the name
Product names are HTML-escaped so 'Кабель <USB-C> & адаптер' renders
The refresh error from an unmodified message is handled
Callback queries are answered on error paths, including unknown or invalid product IDs
Regression tests run updates through the dispatcher rather than only calling functions directly
Existing Russian user-facing strings are preserved
refactor: Every original user-visible string is unchanged
The callback format del:<id> is unchanged
FREE_LIMIT 5, ADMIN 777, and admin bypass behavior are unchanged
The BOT_TOKEN and DB_PATH environment variables are unchanged
The database table and column names are unchanged
Tests compare outgoing Bot API calls or responses through the dispatcher
Code is split so that handlers are separate from data access
The run command is unchanged or the new one is documented
